partnershipPlan: A patient partner who travelled two hours for a knee replacement and a pre-assessment nurse review the charting form and the pathway options.
socialListening: No social media listening; anonymised patient comments about postponed joint replacement operations are read from the centre's feedback system.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I had arranged my daughter to stay for the week, and three days before they said my blood was too low.
items.implication: Screen early enough that postponement is rare and explained.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Four hours in the car for a twenty-minute drip.
items.implication: Chart outreach and single-visit iron options.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The surgeon sees the result, the GP gets a copy, and nobody treats it.
items.implication: Name one owner for an abnormal result.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If you tell us at referral, we can start iron months before you ever see them.
items.implication: Chart primary care screening at referral.

summary: Four composite voices on postponement, travel, ownership and primary care.
